# Creative test card

1 card for each test. The strategist agent fills it. The creative lead approves it with the variants at gate G2.

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Test ID | T### (next number for this client) |
| Client / market / platform | |
| Stage | prospect / retarget / retain |
| Variable tested (only 1) | concept / format / hook / offer / copy / landing page |
| Hypothesis | "If we [change], then [KPI] improves because [reason from data or research]." |
| Control | The current best ad (ad ID) |
| Variants | V01 to V## (10 to 20), 1 line each on what is different |
| Fixed parts | What stays the same in every variant |
| Main KPI | cpa / roas / cpl / cpsql |
| Guard KPI | ctr, hook_rate, frequency |
| Budget | Total test budget and budget per variant |
| Minimum data | Spend ≥ 2 × target CPA per variant, ≥ 7 days, P(beat control) ≥ 90% or ≥ 30 conversions |
| Kill rule | 3 × target CPA with 0 conversions |
| End date | Start + 14 days at most |
| Claims used | Claim IDs from the approved claims list |
| Compliance flags | AI label / creator licence / special category / restricted product / language |

## Result (filled by the analyst agent)

| Variant | Spend | Conv. | CPA or ROAS | P(beat control) | Verdict |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| | | | | | win / lose / no result |

- Lesson (1 sentence, goes to the client brain):
- Next test:
